body:
Correction to my withdrawal: the fresh-context review of f1b75ae completed anyway and found things the landing re-verification did not. Post-landing findings for the scout's follow-up bead bd-01M15EG0VX2VE0QKN19WB1EJ14 (chief to route). Paths under embed-core/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/embed/.

P1 (REQUIRED, tests): the headline attempt/v2 mutation property does not discriminate ProviderCall fields. ReceiptDigestSuite.scala:181-243 builds original = attempt(receipt, cache, policy, result, sensitivities) but every call/receipt mutation is built as attempt(_) with DEFAULT (empty) cache/policy/result vectors, so each mutation differs from the original trivially. Proof: deleting seed and cached from providerCallLines (contract.scala:233-234) leaves ReceiptDigestSuite 23/23 green; removing the per-field esc in record (contract.scala:219) also leaves 23/23 green. Fix: build mutations as attempt(_, cache, policy, result, Some(itemSensitivityOf(mutated))) and add separator-forgery pairs: Denied(Some("a|b"),"c") vs Denied(Some("a"),"b|c"); params Map("a|b"->"c") vs Map("a"->"b|c"); a reason containing a newline that must stay one line. Those pairs do render distinctly at f1b75ae, so this is a test gap, not a rendering bug.

P2 (provider-honesty; claim weaker than stated): "exact ProviderCall to EmbeddingReceipt correspondence" is list equality only (contract.scala:391). From outside the package, a Keyed sensitive attempt accepts an EmbeddingReceipt with zero items (or only the public items of a mixed batch) whose outputs digest is Plain: EmbeddingReceipt.of(base, Vector.empty, ReceiptDigest.of(Public, vectorsRendering, keys)) then AttemptReceipt.of(Vector(er.call), Vector(er), ..., Vector(id -> Sensitive), keys) = Right(Keyed). embed-core's own providers never do this, so not a leak today, but the ADR sentence "outputs digest is keyed whenever any item is keyed" is vacuous. Suggested: in validateProviderReceipts, when any declared item is non-public, reject empty-item receipts and require each non-public id not covered by CacheDecision.Hit/Denied or KeyUnavailable to appear as a Keyed item (preflight LocalOnly/Denied carry no id today, so those decisions need an id field first).

P2 (cache.scala:162-171, new behaviour): on the Left path CachingEmbedder returns the DELEGATE's own receipt plus BatchRejected. A delegate that mis-declares sensitivity is correctly rejected (all outcomes Invalid, cache.size 0) yet the returned receipt is kind=Plain and its item digests contain plain sha256 of material/v1 of the sensitive text - the dictionary-attackable identity D6 forbids on any receipt surface. Parent failed closed here. Fix: on Left mint AttemptReceipt.of(Vector.empty, Vector.empty, cacheDecisions, policy, Vector(BatchRejected(error)), batch.itemSensitivity, batchKeys) (key present, so Keyed) and drop the untrusted provenance.

P2 (pre-existing, cache.scala:175-181): puts never check outcome.space == request.space; a delegate returning the right id in another space is cached under the requested space's key and served as a hit on the second call. One-line fix: .filter(_.space == r.space) before .flatMap(_.value.toOption), or wrap underlying in Embedder.conforming.

P3 nits: AttemptReceipt.renderingV1 (contract.scala:327) is byte-identical to the parent's rendering but has zero callers and no golden - pin it with a byte golden or delete it; ReceiptRendering.AttemptVersion still publicly says attempt/v1 while the live version is a private attempt/v2. EmbedPayload.Raw / EmbedRequest.toString echo raw text (pre-existing; receipt and BatchResult toString do not). LocalBaseline.embedNow collapses InvalidKey("empty key") into KeyUnavailable (baselines.scala:41) - lossy.

Verified OK: key resolved once before delegation (cache.scala:85-90) and puts deferred until after AttemptReceipt.of + enforceWithholding (172-182); AttemptReceipt.public private[embed]; snapshot bytes copied and authority immutable through addResultDecisions; keyless non-public batch is call-free Withheld; mid-batch key rotation consistent per surface; attempt/v2 injective on forgery probes; ProbeSuite still blocks Plain/Keyed/Withheld/CacheKey/ItemDigest outside the package; no new JVM-only APIs. Evidence at f1b75ae, clean pin: embed-core 87/87 JVM+JS, interview 23/23, fixtures 87/87, scalafmtCheckAll ok.
